basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) is recruiting candidates for the Junior Research Fellow / Senior Research Fellow post on a project-based engagement. Applicants must hold a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in relevant engineering, science, or technology disciplines, with national eligibility tests like GATE or NET preferred. The appointment is initially for six months and is extendable, with pay provided as per funding agency norms. Eligible candidates should apply by email by sending a detailed CV to the PI while clearly mentioning the position being applied for in the email

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed CV containing all academic and professional credentials.
Send the CV via email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Mention the correct position in the email subject line as either “Applicant Quantum Communications: JRF” or “Applicant Quantum Communications: SRF”.
Ensure the application reaches the PI by 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore)
QUILA project under NQM (Quantum Communications under National Quantum Mission)
Initially for six months and is extendable
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Senior Research Fellow (SRF)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualifications for their chosen post, while national eligibility tests and specific experience are considered desirable.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate (BE/BTech/BSc or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation/Mathematics/Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Physics/Data Science/AI, or M.Tech/ME/MS in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Computer Science and Engineering or related areas.
rows.desirable_qualification: Qualified in GATE, CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship), or National-level examinations conducted by Central Govt. Departments and their agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc. Experience in communications, resource allocation, quantum technologies, networking, AI/ML and/or optics.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D and / or Master’s degree in the relevant branch of Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Instrumentation/Mathematics/Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Physics/Data Science/AI, or M.Tech/ME/MS in Electrical Engineering/Electronics and Communication/Computer Science and Engineering or related areas preferably with a valid GATE score.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in communications, resource allocation, quantum technologies, networking, AI/ML and/or optics.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment for both JRF and SRF positions is given initially for six months and is extendable. The salary and age limit are provided as per funding agency norms, and selected candidates are encouraged to pursue a PhD.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV containing all academic and professional credentials. Send the CV via email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . Mention the correct position in the email subject line as either “Applicant Quantum Communications: JRF” or “Applicant Quantum Communications: SRF” . Ensure the application reaches the PI by 20 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened by the selection committee, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Selected candidates must join duty immediately upon receiving the offer.

rows.details: Visit the IIT Indore homepage and project details
